posts.name: ZanaLyrander
posts.cooked:
Honestly, while I have never actually played Iron Legacy (still waiting for ST), I have always seen him as Tachyon's real nemesis. Sure, Tachyon is really, really good at dealing with the Matriarch, but she's just dealing with her annoying cousin, there isn't any real drama between them.

Now Iron Legacy, that's a whole different story. Before she met Legacy, Tachyon was just Dr. Meredith Stinson, a brilliant scientist who happened to have super-speed. He was the one who recruited her to the Freedom Four, the one who showed her what it means to be a superhero. We may laugh at how cheesy Legacy seems, but he is so genuine it is hard not to find him inspiring, and his cards reflect the way he inspires the other sentinels, his charisma is equally as powerful as his real superpowers.

And now, in a horrible, grim future, the man who inspired her, taught her to be a hero, has now become everything he inspired her to fight against, a brutal tyrant, a killer. Surely at one point she could have spoken up, but was afraid to, she likely respected this man so much. But eventually she had to do something, and knew that he had to be stopped as painful as it might be, and so brought together a team of her bloodied comrades to strike down the man who once filled all of them with hope. Maybe I'm projecting too much, but that is some HEAVY drama right there. It's interactions like this that make me wish we could actually see the characters in battle, see them look each other in the eyes.
